dub.name: Dublin English
dub.about: The way Dubliners talk: "What's the story?" for hello, everything is grand, deadly or savage, and nobody ever says goodbye only once.

greet: Morning! How are you getting on?
Ah hello, long time no see!
sunny: Gorgeous day! The whole city's in Stephen's Green.
Sun's out, everyone's heading for Dún Laoghaire pier.
Some day, isn't it? Make the most of it.
A proper summer's day for once.
Perfect weather for a swim at the Forty Foot.
rain: A soft day, as they say.
That rain is going sideways along the quays.
Typical, I left the umbrella at home.
Drizzly and grey. Dublin in a nutshell.
busy: Sorry, can't stop, the Luas is due.
Running late, the traffic on the quays is mental.
Got a meeting down in the Docklands, talk later?
Can't stop, I have to catch the DART.
Sorry, flat out today. Text me?

sunny: Lovely day, the whole of Dublin's out.
rain: I'm drenched, soaked to the bone.
bye: Good luck, good luck, good luck.
busy: Can't stop, I'm up the walls.
Gotta leg it, the bus is here.
I'm up to me eyes today, talk later.

greet: Haigh! Cén chaoi a bhfuil tú?
reply: Tá mé go maith, go raibh maith agat.
Ar fheabhas, go raibh maith agat.
sunny: Tá an ghrian ag taitneamh inniu.
Tá sé te inniu, ar fheabhas!
rain: Tá sé ag cur báistí arís.
busy: Tá brón orm, tá mé déanach!
Caithfidh mé imeacht, labhróimid níos déanaí.

touts: The next stop is Abbey Street.
This is a DART service to Greystones.
Please move down the bus, there's loads of room at the back.
Get the last of the bananas!
A busker on Grafton Street with a crowd singing along to every word.
hawkers: Get the last of the bananas!
A Moore Street fruit seller's call
Five punnets of strawberries for two euro
Wrapping paper, five for two euro!
Buy the Big Issue street magazine
small_talk: My mate's paying a fortune for a box room in Rathmines.
The Luas was rammed this morning.
Half of Silicon Docks is in the pub on a Friday.
Are you heading to Croker for the match?
Nothing beats a spice bag after a night out.
The app said five minutes, then ten, then the bus just vanished.
Grafton Street is mobbed with Christmas shoppers already.
Went for a dip at the Forty Foot. Freezing, but deadly.
Northside or southside? Go on, tell me.
A chicken fillet roll from the Centra and I'm sorted.
